controls.title: Logical access security software and infrastructure restrict access to authorized users
Logical access controls protect against threats from outside the system boundaries
Controls prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software
Detection and monitoring procedures identify changes and susceptibilities to vulnerabilities
The entity monitors system components for anomalies indicative of malicious acts
The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could become incidents
The entity responds to identified security incidents by executing a defined program
The entity identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover from incidents
The entity authorizes, designs, tests, and approves changes to infrastructure and software
